newsitem.title: UK: Small explosion at Leeds railway station-operator.
newsitem.headline: Small explosion at Leeds railway station-operator.

text.p: Britain's railway operator Railtrack said on Friday there had been a small explosion at Leeds railway station in northern England.
The blast followed telephoned bomb warnings which closed several railway stations in northwest England and a main highway in the region.
There has been "a small explosion at Leeds railway station in a car park adjacent to the railway station," Britain's Press Association quoted a Railtrack official as saying.
The local fire brigade said it had been called to the scene.
"We have been called to an incident at Riverside car park at City Square Leeds. The incident involves a car," said a spokesman for West Yorkshire Fire Brigade.
Areas of Leeds city centre have been closed off, local police said.
